summary: Fork iteration_92 — validated all 4 priorities (P1 support-user own-visibility, P2 walk-in CRUD + Secrétaire médicale role, P3a user.login event, P3b whatsapp.received event + wa_reply_tokens + #Rcode router). Executed 16 backend pytests (9 existing + 7 new): 16/16 PASS. Frontend E2E on /portal/planning confirms all required data-testids render and the walk-in modal opens correctly (planning-add-walkin-btn → walk-in-modal → patient/phone/doctor/date/motif/save inputs all present). Regression on the previously-shipped WA notification sound feature (iter91) is clean: /me/features still exposes wa_notification_sound + wa_notification_sound_url + wa_notification_volume, /notification-sounds/presets still returns a preset list.

minor.issue: Body schema requires 'title' AND 'template_name' (Pydantic 422 if missing). Not documented in the review request which referenced only 'name'/'event'/'action'/'config'. Not a bug — just a doc/interface note for main agent.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update review-request docs to include the required 'title' + 'template_name' fields on POST /admin/automations (Pydantic model requires them).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _try_handle_masked_reply uses `phone: {$regex: digits_only}` — no anchoring nor escape. If digits_only contains regex-special chars it would be unsafe (unlikely for MSISDN digits, but consider re.escape).
server.py:16553 uses `_re_masked_reply.match(pattern, string, flags)` — module-level match with 3 positional args is correct Python API. OK.

server.py wa_reply_tokens has no TTL index — the code only enforces uniqueness at generation time by scanning `used=false` rows. Consider a MongoDB TTL index on `created_at` (30min) to auto-expire, otherwise the collection will grow unbounded.
WalkInModal.jsx: doctor dropdown pre-selects the first Médecin — good UX. Save button is correctly disabled while patient input is empty (createDisabled flag).

PortalLayout: isSecretaireMedicale gate correctly restricts sidebar to Planning consultations only (mirrors Médecin pattern). Verified in code review; not E2E-tested because bridging a Secrétaire user via UI would require clicking through the admin flow with the daily briefing modal blocker (same E2E friction flagged in iter91).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_fork_p2_p3_extra.py (new — 7 tests covering 403 gating, automation creation on user.login, events labels/descriptions, WA webhook smoke, /me/features regression, /notification-sounds/presets regression, numero_ordre auto-increment)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all planning walk-in data-testids render + modal opens)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own throwaway tenant + tracked users (UUID-tagged emails ending in @sawali-test.com). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend E2E on /portal/planning succeeds ONLY when navigating via `window.location.href = '/portal/planning'` AFTER localStorage.setItem('sawali_token', ...). Direct page.goto('/portal/planning') returns ERR_ABORTED from the ingress. Briefing modal ('J\'ai lu' gate) still blocks first-load /admin flows — same as iter91. Fork P3b _try_handle_masked_reply cannot be end-to-end tested without an admin user with a matching phone number in db.users; smoke-test the webhook path (POST /api/whatsapp/webhook with a fake Meta payload) returned 200 OK confirming no exception path. To assert the wa_reply_tokens row is actually created + whatsapp.received event fires, next agent could add a fixture that seeds a fake admin phone then queries MongoDB directly (db.wa_reply_tokens.find_one({original_sender: from_msisdn})).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs observed. Fork iteration_92 shipping is green.
